ModMetaData.name: More Better Deep Drill
ModMetaData.author: DarthCY
ModMetaData.description:
Adds three types of deep drill to the game.
Ranged deep drill: mine all the resources on the map.
Large deep drill: a bigger ranged deep drill that allows up to 12 colonists to operate it at the same time.
Archotech deep drill: produces a selected resource from the void without relying on map deposits.
